objective: Determine if the catalogue contains a product variant matching the described Nut Bolt and Washer from Heco with brand 'Heco', series containing 'Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer', fastener type 'bolt', and diameter '8 mm'.

params.series: literal 'Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer'
params.method: Lookup from product_variants using normalized case-insensitive matching on brand and series, and verify existence of product_variant_properties with property_key 'fastener_type' and value 'bolt', and property_key 'diameter' and value '8 mm'.

constraints.rule: To answer ‘do you carry product X’, resolve the product using NORMALIZED / case-insensitive tokenized matching (ILIKE on the key tokens of brand + kind + descriptive attributes) on the product catalogue table — do NOT use exact full-string `series =` equality.

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Product {product_name} (SKU: {product_sku}) is available in the catalogue.
